name: bridge-behavior-tests
description: Behavioral tests for the shipped tiro-swm-bridge.js. Runs the real bridge bytes against a stub <tiro-form-filler> that models the @tiro-health/web-sdk element's observable semantics. Zero dependencies: node --test only, no jsdom, no network. Complements build/bridge-contract (static type-check) and the Playwright smoke test tracked in #26.
